steps.name: Create payment page via API and open checkout URL
API: Create payment page for order test_fd575afe
$("open") https://payment-page.solidgate.com/link/01574268-ed5e-43c0-afa6-8a5fd4b0172d
$("webdriver") create()
UI: Read displayed amount from Payment Page
$("[data-testid='price_major']") should be([visible, 30 s.])
$("[data-testid='price_major']") get text()
UI: Pay with test card VISA_SUCCESS
$("[data-testid='cardNumber']") should be([visible, 30 s.])
$("[data-testid='cardNumber']") set value(4067429974719265)
UI: Fill expiry date: 08/29
$("[data-testid='cardExpiryDate']") should be(visible)
$("[data-testid='cardExpiryDate']") set value(08/29)
UI: Fill CVV
$("[data-testid='cardCvv']") should be(visible)
$("[data-testid='cardCvv']") set value(123)
UI: Submit payment
$("[data-testid='submit']") should be(visible)
$("[data-testid='submit']") click()
UI: Verify payment completed successfully
$("[data-testid='status-title']") should be([visible, 60 s.])
$("[data-testid='status-title']") should have(text "successful")
$("[data-testid='retryable-payment-error']") should not(exist)
